lines.display: Which prefecture in Japan has the most *foreign* *residents*?
lines.spoken: Which prefecture in Japan has the most foreign residents?

lines.display: Japan now has a *record* 4.28 million of them.
lines.spoken: Japan now has a record four point two eight million of them.
Let's count down the top five.
Number five: Sai-tama.
About three hundred and six thousand people,

lines.display: up almost *15,000* in just six months.
lines.spoken: up almost fifteen thousand in just six months.
Number four: Kana-gawa.
About three hundred and thirty-two thousand,
home to Yokohama's famous Chinatown.
Number three: Eye-chee.
About three hundred and seventy thousand,
the heart of Japan's car industry.

lines.display: It used to be number two, until its rival *overtook* it.
lines.spoken: It used to be number two, until its rival overtook it.
Number two: Oh-saka.
About three hundred and ninety thousand,
up more than fifty percent since twenty twenty.
And number one...
Tokyo.
Eight hundred and twenty-four thousand people.
That's more than Oh-saka and Eye-chee combined.

lines.display: Nearly *1* *in* *5* foreign residents in Japan lives here.
lines.spoken: Nearly one in five foreign residents in Japan lives here.

lines.display: Together, these five hold over *half* of all foreign residents in Japan.
lines.spoken: Together, these five hold over half of all foreign residents in Japan.
Which one would you call home?
